My hypothesis on this, is that you would create a system that seeks an equilibrium with government dependence verse individual dependence with political power representing the indicative curve. Something similar to the supply and demand curve. As political power increases the tendency to take more from government would increase. The effect working against this is the loss of political power if you take too much. Now the problem that may occur would be due to the fact that this is what we in engineering would refer to as a bang bang control system. You either have the right to vote or you don't. This inherently would cause some sort of oscillation around the normative point. This may or may not be a bad thing depending on the size of the oscillation. A better form of control, but impractical to implement system would be one where you scale you political power with the amount you pay in. The problem with this is the precise quantification of net in verse net out for each individual.

Another problem is that having influence over the system (in the form of money and campaign contributions) would net you further control of the system since the wealthiest private demographic would be the only one that's secure in its continued right to vote. I'm not worried so much about government officials abusing the system as I'm worried about demographics with no money also having no political voice. I think this boils down to two main points:

  • Wealth becomes the only thing that secures your right to vote, and lack of wealth removes this right.
  • People who lack the right to vote are still subject to the governmental process that they no longer have say in

I think with this kind of system, for all its good intentions, we'd end up with a situation where the wealthy private powers and the entrenched political powers would work together to make as many other demographics poorer and thus unable to vote. Both the wealthy and politically powerful have a common interest in keeping the wealthy voice the most politically powerful.

Finally, if you can be poor and self sufficient you can regain your power. The idea of self sufficiency at whatever income is the core of this idea. Someone who can make it work with very little income will be someone who has the character to make good decisions on candidates.
